about.title: Ukwakha izisombululo zeDijithali Eziqhubela phambili amaShishini
about.description:
I-Oklut Technologies yinkampani yezisombululo zeteknoloji egxile ekuncedeni amashishini aguqule iingcamango zibe ngamava anentsingiselo yedijithali. Sidibanisa itekhnoloji, ubuchule, kunye nokuqonda kweshishini ukuhambisa izisombululo eziyilwe ngokweemfuno zehlabathi lokwenyani.

Ukusuka kwinguqu yedijithali kunye nophuhliso lwesoftware yesiko ukuya kwilifu, i-AI, i-automation, kunye neenkonzo zobuchwepheshe ezilawulwayo, sinceda imibutho yenze lula ukuntsonkotha, iphucule ukusebenza kakuhle, kunye nokudala ixabiso ledijithali elihlala lihleli.

Indlela yethu ilula — qonda ingxaki, kwaye yakha itekhnoloji echanekileyo.

section1.title: 1. Ulwazi esiluqokelelayo
body: Siqokelela iinkcukacha ozinikezela ngokuthe ngqo (ezifana negama lakho kunye nedilesi ye-imeyile xa ufaka ifom yoqhagamshelwano okanye usenza i-akhawunti) kunye nolwazi oluqokelelwe ngokuzenzekelayo ngeekuki kunye nobuchwepheshe obufanayo, obufana namaphepha ahanjelwe, uhlobo lwesixhobo kunye nendawo eqikelelweyo.

section2.title: 2. Indlela esizisebenzisa ngayo iiKuki
body: Icookies eziyimfuneko zihlala zivuliwe kuba iwebhusayithi ayikwazi ukusebenza kakuhle ngaphandle kwazo. Bagcina iseshoni kunye nemeko yokuqinisekisa kwaye bakhumbule ukhetho lwakho lwecookie.

iikuki ze-Analytics zisinceda siqonde indlela abatyeleli abayisebenzisa ngayo indawo ukuze siyiphucule. Iikuki zentengiso zisetyenziselwa ukubonisa unikezelo olufanelekileyo kunye namaphulo. Ezi ndidi zenziwa ukuba zisebenze kuphela ngemvume yakho kwaye zinokutshintshwa nangaliphi na ixesha kwiqela lenjongo yecookie.

section3.title: 3. Isiseko soMthetho (GDPR)
body: Sicubungula idatha yobuqu kwezi ziseko zomthetho zilandelayo: imvume yakho (yeekuki ezingabalulekanga kunye nokuthengisa), ukusebenza kwekhontrakthi (yeenkonzo ozicelayo), isibophelelo somthetho, kunye nomdla osemthethweni apho amalungelo akho angazigqithisi. Ungayirhoxisa imvume nangaliphi na ixesha ngaphandle kokuchaphazela ukuba semthethweni kwenkqubo eqhutywe phambi kokurhoxiswa.

section4.title: 4. Amalungelo Akho
body: Ngokuxhomekeke kwindawo okuyo, unokuba nelungelo lokufikelela, ukulungisa, ukucima, okanye ukunqanda ukusetyenzwa kwedatha yakho yobuqu, ukuchasa ukusetyenzwa, kunye nokuphatheka kwedatha. Ungafaka isikhalazo kugunyaziwe olawulayo wengingqi yakho.

section5.title: 5. Ukugcinwa kwedatha & noKhuseleko

Iinkqubo zethu zoLwazi kunye neeNgxelo zeNgxelo zinceda imibutho iqokelele, iququzelele, ihlalutye, kwaye ibonise ulwazi lweshishini ngokusebenzisa iinkqubo zolwazi ezicwangcisiweyo, amaqonga engxelo, iideshibhodi, kunye nokuhamba komsebenzi okuzenzekelayo.

Imibutho isoloko inolwazi olusasazwe kuzo zonke izicelo, i-spreadsheets, i-database, kunye neenkqubo zokusebenza. Oku kwenza kube nzima ukuseka imbono engaguqukiyo yokusebenza kweshishini. Sinceda ukudibanisa imithombo yolwazi kwindawo yokunika ingxelo ecwangcisiweyo ebonelela ngolwazi oluthembekileyo, olufikelelekayo, kunye noluhambelanayo lweshishini.
transformation: Inkqubo yokunika ingxelo akufuneki ibonise amanani nje. Kufuneka incede abasebenzisi baqonde ukusebenza, bachonge iingxaki, bafumane amathuba, kwaye benze izigqibo ezizizo.
Siyila iimeko zokunika ingxelo malunga nendlela umbutho wakho osebenza ngayo, sinikezela ngedatha ecwangcisiweyo ukuya kwisigqibo sendalo esingqongileyo eyenzelwe onke amanqanaba olawulo.

customDevelopment.description: Ukuphela kophuhliso lwezisombululo zedijithali ezitsha ezivela kwiimfuno zoshishino kunye noyilo lwesisombululo ngophuhliso, ukudibanisa, ukuvavanywa, ukuthunyelwa, kunye nenkxaso eqhubekayo.
customDevelopment.row1Title: Ukuphela-ukuya-ekuphelweni koPhuhliso ukusuka kwiiMfuno ukuya kwisikali
customDevelopment.row1P1: Onke amanyathelo amatsha edijithali aqala ngeemfuno ezizodwa, ukuhamba komsebenzi, kunye neenjongo ezicwangcisiweyo ezingenako ukufezekiswa ngesoftware enobungakanani obulingana nayo yonke. Sisebenza ngokukhethekileyo ekwakheni isiko, iinkqubo zesoftware esebenza kakhulu ukusuka ekuqaleni.
customDevelopment.row1P2: Ukusuka kwiimfuno zokuqala zokufunyanwa kunye noyilo loyilo lobugcisa ukuya kuphuhliso oluluqilima lwesprint, ukuhlanganiswa kwe-API ye-ecosystem, imibhobho yovavanyo eyomeleleyo, kunye nokusasazwa kwamafu okuzenzekelayo, amaqela ethu aphezulu obunjineli athatha ubunini obupheleleyo bomjikelo wemveliso yakho.
customDevelopment.row2P1: Siyila ii-architectures zesoftware eyomelelayo eyenzelwe ukumelana nomthwalo onzima wemveliso. Ukusuka kwii-microservices zemodyuli kunye nee-backends eziqhutywa ngumnyhadala ukuya kwimithombo yedatha ephezulu kunye ne-GraphQL/REST APIs, sakha amaqonga akhula ngokukhawuleza.
customDevelopment.row2P2: Ngokuseka iziseko zekhowudi ezicocekileyo, zemodyuli ezidityaniswe novavanyo oluzenzekelayo kunye nokuthotyelwa kokhuseleko oluqhubekayo, siqinisekisa ukuba isiseko sakho sesoftware sinokugcinwa, sinokuphicothwa, kwaye silungele ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kwexesha elide.
customDevelopment.row3P1: Imodeli yethu yokuhambisa ifakela iyunithi ezenzekelayo, ukudibanisa, kunye nokuphela kokuphela kovavanyo lokubuyela emva ecaleni kwe-CI/CD workflows ene-container (Docker, Kubernetes, AWS/Azure/GCP).
customDevelopment.row3P2: Ngee-demos ze-sprint ezicacileyo, ukubonwa kwexesha langempela, kunye nesantya esiqhutywa ngokukhawuleza, siqinisekisa ixesha elikhawulezayo ukuya kwintengiso ngaphandle kokuphazamisa ukhuseleko, ukuzinza, okanye amava omsebenzisi.
customDevelopment.row4Title: Ukuthembeka kwe-24/7 yemisebenzi kunye nokuZiphendukela kweXesha elide
customDevelopment.row4P1: Ukuphila sisiqalo nje. Sinikezela ngohlolo olusebenzayo, ukugcinwa kwe-SLA-backed, usetyenziso lweziseko zelifu, ukulungiswa kokusebenza, kunye nokukhutshwa kwezinto okuqhubekayo.
customDevelopment.row4P2: Iqela lethu lobunjineli lisebenza njengolwandiso lwendalo lombutho wakho, liqinisekisa ukuba akukho xesha lokuphumla kunye nokuphakama kobuchwepheshe obuqhubekayo kwimarike yakho.
customDevelopment.pillarsSub: Gqibezela izakhono ezigcweleyo ezenzelwe ukuthatha izimvo zakho ukusuka kwiqanda ukuya kwimveliso.
customDevelopment.pillar1Desc: Uhlalutyo lweshishini olunzulu, iinkcukacha zokusebenza, kunye nemephu yohambo lomsebenzisi ukuchaza imida yesisombululo esichanekileyo.
customDevelopment.pillar2Desc: Ulwakhiwo lwendalo olusefu, umfuziselo wesiseko sedatha, uyilo lweenkonzo ezincinci, kunye neziseko zokhuseleko ezingenathemba.
customDevelopment.pillar3Desc: Iwebhu yangoku enestakhi esigcweleyo kunye nezicelo eziphathwayo ezenziwe ngekhowudi ecocekileyo, uhlobo lokhuseleko, kunye nemigangatho ye-UI esebenzayo.
customDevelopment.pillar4Desc: I-High-throughput REST/GraphQL APIs, ii-orchestrations ze-webhook, amasango entlawulo, kunye ne-seamless yeqela lesithathu le-ERP/CRM sync.
customDevelopment.ctaTitle: Ukulungele ukwakha iSisombululo sakho ukusuka kwiNqalo ukuya kwi-Deployment?
customDevelopment.ctaSub: Iqabane kunye ne-Oklut Technologies kwi-architect, injineli, kunye nokuhambisa iqonga lakho ledijithali eliqhelekileyo ukusuka kwiimfuno zoshishino ukuya kwinyani yemveliso.
customDevelopment.pillar5Desc: Uvavanyo oluluqilima oluzenzekelayo, uvavanyo lomthwalo/loxinzelelo, ukuskena ubuthathaka, kunye namagumbi ovavanyo lokubuyela umva.
customDevelopment.pillar6Desc: I-automated CI/CD pipelines, i-container orchestration (Docker/K8s), iziseko zophuhliso njengekhowudi, kunye nokukhutshwa kwe-zero-downtime.
customDevelopment.pillar7Desc: 24/7 iliso elibukhali, itelemetry yezempilo, uphicotho-zincwadi lwentsebenzo, ukupakishwa kokhuseleko, kunye nokugcinwa okuqhubekayo kwe-SLA.
customDevelopment.pillar8Desc: Isantya sophawu oluqhelekileyo, ukudityaniswa kohlalutyo lwedatha, ukuphuculwa kwe-AI, kunye nokuphuculwa kwezakhiwo.

processAutomation.row4P2: Uxilongo lokufunda koomatshini oluqhubekayo lufumanisa amathuba amatsha okuzisebenzela, ukugcina ishishini lakho lisebenza ngobuchule obukhulu.

processAutomation.pillar1Desc: Amanyathelo amaninzi omntu-kwi-loop kunye nokuhamba komsebenzi wedijithali okucwangcisiweyo kunye neendlela ezizenzekelayo kunye nokunyuka.

centreOfExcellence.row2P1: Sizama ngeemodeli zokufunda zoomatshini zangoku, ii-arhente ze-AI zesiko, kunye ne-automation ye-stelligent workflow automation ukwakha iimveliso zeshishini kwisizukulwana esilandelayo.

centreOfExcellence.row2F2: I-arhente ye-AI eZimeleyo i-autonomous ye-automation process yeshishini
centreOfExcellence.row2F3: Imodeli yokufunda yomatshini wokwenza kunye nokulungiswa kakuhle
centreOfExcellence.row3Title: UYilo lweLifu loShishino kunye noKhuseleko lweZero-Trust
centreOfExcellence.row3P1: Siyila kwaye silawula okusingqongileyo okunokomelela kwamafu amaninzi okwakhiwe kukhuseleko lwezikhokelo zokhuseleko, siqinisekisa ukuba idatha yakho ihlala ikhuselwe kwizisongelo ze-cyber zehlabathi.
centreOfExcellence.row3F1: I-AWS, i-Azure, kunye ne-GCP i-orchestration yeziseko zophuhliso zamafu amaninzi
centreOfExcellence.row3F2: I-Zero-trust yokufikelela kwinethiwekhi (ZTNA) kunye nemigaqo-nkqubo ye-IAM esekelwe kwindima
centreOfExcellence.row3F3: Ukuskena okuzenzekelayo kokhuseleko lwesikhongozeli kunye nolawulo oluyimfihlo
centreOfExcellence.pillarsSub: Iincwadi zokudlala zophuhliso ezicwangcisiweyo zinika amandla amaqonga abalulekileyo kubuthunywa.
centreOfExcellence.pillar1Desc: Ukongamela olubanzi oluqinisekisa ukuba zonke izisombululo zeshishini zihambelana nobukhulu obungqongqo, ukhuseleko, kunye nemigaqo yokuthotyelwa.
centreOfExcellence.pillar2Title: Izikhawulezisi eziSebenziswa kwakhona kunye neThala leeNcwadi leCandelo
centreOfExcellence.pillar2Desc: Iinkqubo zoyilo lobunikazi, iikiti zokuqalisa i-API, kunye ne-backend microservice templates ukunciphisa ixesha lokuqala lophuhliso nge-40%.
centreOfExcellence.pillar3Desc: Imibhobho ekwinqanaba eliphezulu lokujongwa kwexesha lokwenyani elibeka iliso kwi-latency yesicelo, imiqobo yokuphuma, kunye nokusetyenziswa komthombo wamafu.
centreOfExcellence.pillar4Desc: Imibutho yangaphakathi emiselweyo kunye neziqinisekiso ezihlakulela ubuchule obunzulu bobugcisa kwilifu, i-DevOps, kunye ne-AI esetyenziswayo.
centreOfExcellence.ctaSub: Iqabane kunye neZiko le-Oklut Tech lokuGqwesa ukwakha i-architectures yefu eyomelelayo, i-automate workflows, kunye nokukhawulezisa ukuhanjiswa kwemveliso yedijithali.
centreOfExcellence.p1Desc: Ukuseka ulawulo loyilo lweshishini ngokubanzi, izikhokelo zomgaqo-nkqubo, kunye nemigangatho yokuthotyelwa.
centreOfExcellence.p2Desc: Chaza ulwakhiwo lwereferensi yala maxesha, imfumba yeteknoloji evavanyiweyo, kunye neepateni zeenkonzo ezincinci.
centreOfExcellence.p3Title: Ii-asethi eziphinda zisetyenziswe kunye namathala eencwadi
centreOfExcellence.p3Desc: Ukukhawulezisa isantya sophuhliso kunye namacandelo ekwabelwana ngawo, iitemplates, izixhobo zokuqalisa, kunye neenkqubo zokuyila.
centreOfExcellence.p4Desc: Uqeqesho olucwangcisiweyo, ingcebiso kubuchwepheshe, kunye nokwenziwa kwezakhono ukuphakamisa ubuchule bobunjineli beqela.
centreOfExcellence.p5Desc: I-R & D kwii-arhente ze-AI, iipayipi ezizenzekelayo, kunye nezicwangciso zesizukulwana esilandelayo ukugcina umda wemarike.
centreOfExcellence.p6Desc: Iimetriki zobunjineli eziqhutywa yidatha (DORA), i-benchmarking ye-SLA, kunye nokuphucula umgangatho oqhubekayo.

solutionEngineering.description: Uphuhliso kunye nokwandiswa kwezicelo, amaqonga, ukuhamba komsebenzi, kunye nezisombululo zeshishini ukujongana neemfuno ezizodwa zoshishino kunye nokunikezela ukusebenza okulungiselelweyo.
solutionEngineering.row1Title: Iimpawu zeBespoke ezakhelwe ukuhamba kwakho komsebenzi
solutionEngineering.row1P1: Isoftware yeshishini elisemgangathweni isoloko isilela ekuhlangabezaneni neemfuno ezikhethekileyo zoshishino. Iqela lethu lobunjineli besiko liphuhlisa iimodyuli zesicelo se-bespoke, imithetho yesiko loshishino, kunye nolwandiso olukhethekileyo olulungiselelwe imisebenzi yakho.
solutionEngineering.row1P2: Ukusuka kwiCRM yesiko kunye nezixhasi zeERP ukuya kwiiphothali ezikhethekileyo zokusebenza, sakha iimpawu ezilungelelaniswa ngaphandle komthungo neepateni zokuhamba komsebenzi zeqela lakho kanye.
solutionEngineering.row2P1: Qhagamshela iisistim ezohlukeneyo zesoftware kwi-ecosystem yedijithali emanyeneyo. Siyinjineli yesiko le-REST kunye ne-GraphQL APIs, abaphathi bewebhu, kunye nemigca yemiyalezo yeshishini ukuqinisekisa ukuvumelanisa idatha yexesha lokwenyani kuwo onke amaqonga akho.
solutionEngineering.row2P2: Nokuba ngaba kudityaniswa izixhobo ze-SaaS zeqela lesithathu okanye ukwandiswa kwamaqonga omnini-ndawo, ulwakhiwo lwethu oludityanisiweyo lubeka phambili ukuthembeka kwedatha, i-throughput, kunye ne-zero downtime.
solutionEngineering.row3P1: Ukuphakamisa unxibelelwano lwelifa kunye namava ala maxesha, aphendulayo omsebenzisi ayilelwe isantya kunye nokucaca. Siphinda siphucula iindawo ezingaphambili ezineepateni zoyilo ezicacileyo, ukufikeleleka kokuthotyelwa, kunye neemodeli zonxibelelwano ezilungelelanisiweyo.
solutionEngineering.row3P2: Ngokunxuseneyo, iinjineli zethu zokusebenza zikhulisa imibuzo yedatabase, izicwangciso ze-caching, kunye nobungakanani bebhandle engaphambili ukuhambisa amaxesha okuphendula ngoko nangoko kuzo zonke izixhobo.
solutionEngineering.pillarsSub: Iindlela zokwenziwa ngokwezifiso koShishino ezakhelwe ukukala ngokungenamthungo.
solutionEngineering.pillar1Desc: Ingqiqo yesicelo esilungelelanisiweyo kunye noomatshini belizwe abazenzekelayo abalungiselelwe ngokukodwa malunga nemithetho yakho yokusebenza yangaphakathi.
solutionEngineering.pillar2Desc: Iibhulorho zedatha ezikhuselekileyo, eziqinisekisiweyo ezidibanisa i-backends zabanikazi, ii-ERP suites, i-gateways yentlawulo, kunye neenkonzo zefu.
solutionEngineering.pillar3Desc: Uhlengahlengiso olunzulu lolwakhiwo oluguqula isoftware yeshishini ngaphandle kokwaphula iindlela zokuphucula okanye izivumelwano zenkxaso yomthengisi.
solutionEngineering.pillar4Desc: Umbuzo ondlongondlongo wokuchaza iprofayili, ukupheliswa kokuvuza kwememori, kunye nokuhanjiswa kweCDN edge kumthwalo wephepha elingaphantsi lesibini.
solutionEngineering.ctaTitle: Ngaba ukulungele ukwenza iQonga loShishino lwakho?
solutionEngineering.ctaSub: Qhagamshelana nezisombululo zethu zabayili ukuyila kunye nokuhambisa iimodyuli zesiko, ukuhamba komsebenzi, kunye nokudibanisa okulungiselelwe iimfuno zeshishini lakho.

digitalTransformation.description: Uphuculo olubanzi lweenkqubo zoshishino, uyilo lweteknoloji, kunye neemodeli zokusebenza ukuqhubela phambili ukulungelelaniswa kombutho, ukusebenza kakuhle, kunye nokukhula kwedijithali okuzinzileyo.
digitalTransformation.row1Title: Ukusuka kuMbono ukuya kwiMap yeNdlela eSebenzayo
digitalTransformation.row1P1: Sisebenzisana neenkokheli zoshishino ukuchaza iqhinga ledijithali, iimeko zoshishino, kunye nemigaqo yendlela enqanyuliweyo kunye nokuphumelela ngokukhawuleza kunye nokubulawa kwabantu abasengozini.
digitalTransformation.row1P2: Amanyathelo abekwe phambili, imifuziselo ye-TCO, kunye nee-KPIs ziqinisekisa zonke iinzame zokuphucula iteknoloji zibophelela ngqo kwingeniso, ukusebenza kakuhle, kunye neziphumo zokwaneliseka kwabathengi.
digitalTransformation.row2Title: Yenza iXesha Eliqhelekileyo Ngaphandle Kokwaphula Ishishini
digitalTransformation.row2P1: Ukubuyisela kwakhona i-monoliths kwi-microservices, i-APIs, kunye neepateni zefu-zendalo kunye ne-zero-downtime cutovers kunye nokuqinisekiswa kwe-regression ngokuzenzekelayo.
digitalTransformation.row2P2: Siphucula usetyenziso, ugcino-lwazi, kunye namaleko okudibanisa ngelixa sigcina ukuthotyelwa kunye nokuma kokhuseleko.
digitalTransformation.row3Title: Ulwamkelo lwamafu kunye nobukrelekrele obuqhutywa yiDatha
digitalTransformation.row3P1: Yamkela i-AWS, i-Azure, kunye ne-GCP, yakha imibhobho yedatha yanamhlanje, kwaye ifake i-agent yokufunda koomatshini ukuqhuba izigqibo ezizimeleyo.
digitalTransformation.row3P2: Ukusuka kwiminyhadala yexesha lokwenyani ukuya kwiideshbhodi ezidityanisiweyo, inguqu iyalinganiseka kwaye igcineke.
digitalTransformation.row4P1: Yiyila ngokutsha iihambo zabathengi kuyo yonke iwebhu ephendulayo, i-iOS, i-Android, kunye neephothali ezizisebenzelayo ezinonxibelelwano olulolwakho.
digitalTransformation.row4P2: Ubunjineli bePlatform, i-telemetry, kunye ne-automated feedback loops zenza i-digital innovation iqhubeke.
digitalTransformation.pillarsSub: Izixhasi ezijolise kwiziphumo eziqinisekisa ubunkokheli obuzinzileyo bedijithali.
digitalTransformation.pillar1Desc: Izicwangciso zenguqu ezikwizigaba ezinemodeli yeshishini, ulawulo loyilo lwezakhiwo, kunye nokulandelela umngcipheko.
digitalTransformation.pillar2Desc: I-AWS/Azure/GCP iziseko zamafu amaninzi, imibhobho ezenzekelayo, kunye nokusetyenziswa kohlalutyo lwedatha yeshishini.
digitalTransformation.pillar3Desc: Iinkqubo ezizihambelayo zobukrelekrele, ii-arhente ze-AI zokuqonda, kunye ne-telemetry eqikelelweyo ukuze kuphuculwe imisebenzi yemihla ngemihla.
digitalTransformation.pillar4Desc: Iiphothali zedijithali ze-omnichannel eziphezulu kunye nojongano olulolwakho olwakhelwe ukugcinwa kwabasebenzisi okuphezulu.
digitalTransformation.ctaSub: Iqabane kunye ne-Oklut Technologies yenguqu yedijithali enezigaba, engenamngciphekweni ebotshelelwe kwiziphumo zoshishino ezinokulinganiswa.

endToEndSolutions.description: Isakhelo esicwangcisiweyo, esipheleleyo sonikezelo lwenkqubo ebandakanya iimfuno zeshishini, uyilo loyilo lwezakhiwo, ubunjineli, ukudibanisa, ukuqinisekiswa komgangatho, ukuhanjiswa kwamafu, kunye nemisebenzi elawulwayo.
endToEndSolutions.row1P1: Iindibano zocweyo ezisebenzisanayo, imephu yesizinda seshishini, kunye neenkcukacha zezakhiwo zefu ezenzelwe ukuphelisa umngcipheko ngaphambi kokuba kubhalwe umgca wekhowudi.
endToEndSolutions.row1P2: Sichaza imifuziselo yedatha, izikhokelo zokhuseleko, kunye neziganeko ezibalulekileyo ezibeka impumelelo yexesha elide.
endToEndSolutions.row2P1: Ii-microservices zemodyuli, i-APIs yohlobo olukhuselekileyo, kunye ne-frontends ephendulayo edibeneyo kunye neyunithi ezenzekelayo, ukudibanisa, kunye nokukhusela ukhuseleko.
endToEndSolutions.row2P2: Imibhobho yokudibanisa eqhubekayo kunye ne-GitHub Actions, Terraform, kunye ne-automated guardrails.
endToEndSolutions.row3P1: I-orchestration enamafu amaninzi kwi-AWS/Azure/GCP ene-automated rollback, i-zero-downtime cutovers, kunye nokubonwa kwexesha lokwenyani.
endToEndSolutions.row3P2: Sibonelela ngolondolozo oluxhaswa yi-SLA kunye nokubekw' esweni okuqhubekekayo kwe-telemetry ukuvelisa imveliso yakho ngaphandle komthungo.
endToEndSolutions.row4P1: Uxanduva lokuphendula ngenqaku elinye kuyo yonke isitakhi sakho sedijithali - isantya sokubaleka esicacileyo, uqingqo-mali oluqikelelwayo, kunye nokwenziwa kwezinto ezintsha okuqhubekayo.
endToEndSolutions.row4P2: Ukukhutshwa kwamanqaku rhoqo kunye nemijikelo yophuculo kugcina ishishini lakho liphambili kukhuphiswano.
endToEndSolutions.pillar1Desc: Ukufunyaniswa kwendawo, iimephu zendlela zoyilo, kunye nolungelelwaniso lwabachaphazelekayo ukuphelisa ubungozi bokubulawa.
endToEndSolutions.pillar2Desc: Ii-microservices ezizinzileyo zamafu, ukuhlanganiswa kwe-API, kunye novavanyo oluqhubekayo lwe-QA.
endToEndSolutions.pillar3Desc: Zero-trust ukuthotyelwa kokhuseleko, ukukhutshwa kwesikhongozeli, kunye nokuthunyelwa kwamafu okuzenzekelayo.
endToEndSolutions.pillar4Desc: 24/7 esweni SLA, telemetry impilo, kunye nobunjineli evolution eqhubekayo.
endToEndSolutions.ctaTitle: Ngaba ufuna iqabane elipheleleyo lomjikelo woBomi?
endToEndSolutions.ctaSub: Singabanini bomjikelo wetekhnoloji epheleleyo ukuze iqela lakho ligxile kwiziphumo eziphambili zoshishino.

migrationServices.description: Ukufuduka okukhuselekileyo, okucwangcisiweyo kwezicelo zelifa, oovimba beenkcukacha, kunye neziseko ezingundoqo ukuya kuyilo lwale mihla lwamafu, ludityaniswe nenkqubo yophuculo oluqhubekayo ukwenzela ukomelezwa kobuchule kunye nempumelelo.
migrationServices.row1P1: Ukufuduka komsebenzi okungenamthungo kwi-AWS, i-Azure, kunye neLifu likaGoogle ngokufunyanwa okuzenzekelayo, ukucwangciswa kwamaza, kunye nokuphazamiseka kweshishini.
migrationServices.row1P2: Silungelelanisa ukubuyiswa kwakhona, ukulungiswa kwakhona, kunye nokuhlengahlengiswa ukuze kulungiswe ixabiso lilonke lobunini (TCO) kunye nobuchule.
migrationServices.row2Title: Khusela i-ETL kunye noQinisekiso lweDatha oluSebenzayo
migrationServices.row2P1: Ukuphindaphindwa kwedatha ezenzekelayo, ukuguqulelwa kwe-schema, kunye nemibhobho ye-ETL ephezulu kunye ne-100% yokuqinisekisa ingqibelelo yedatha.
migrationServices.row2P2: I-Zero-downtime cutover rehearsal iqinisekisa ukuhambelana okupheleleyo kwedatha kunye nokuqhubekeka kweshishini.
migrationServices.row3P1: Yenza imonoliths ibe yesimanjemanje kwiinkonzo ezincinci ezilungelelaniswe ngeKubernetes (EKS, AKS, GKE) ngeplani ye-IaC ezenzekelayo.
migrationServices.row3P2: Iprofayili yokusebenza emva kokufuduka kunye nokulungiswa kweendleko kuqinisekisa i-ROI yangoku.
migrationServices.row4Title: Uvavanyo oluzenzekelayo kunye neMinatha yoKhuseleko lwe-Rollback
migrationServices.row4P1: Ii-cutover runbooks ezivavanywe idabi, ii-automated regression suites, kunye neendlela ezikhawulezayo zokubuyela umva ukuze ube noxolo lwengqondo olupheleleyo.
migrationServices.row4P2: I-telemetry yezempilo ye-Post-migration kunye ne-24/7 hypercare iqinisekisa ukuzinza kwemveliso engenasiphako.
migrationServices.pillarsSub: Iintshukumo zokususwa emngciphekweni zixhaswa yi-SLAs zamashishini.
migrationServices.pillar1Desc: Ukukhutshwa kweCanary kunye ne-database yokuvumelanisa kabini-bhala ukuqinisekisa ukufikelela komsebenzisi okungaphazanyiswa.
migrationServices.pillar2Desc: Uthelekiso lwe-Checksum, uphicotho lwengqibelelo ye-schema, kunye nolungelelwaniso oluzenzekelayo lwe-ETL.
migrationServices.pillar3Desc: Iiprothokholi ezingqongqo zokubuyisela iintlekele kunye noqheliselo lokuphinda luqulathe umngcipheko kwinqanaba ngalinye.
migrationServices.pillar4Desc: Ukunikezelwa kwamalungelo kwifu, imigaqo-nkqubo ye-autoscaling, kunye needashbhodi zolawulo lweendleko zibandakanyiwe.
migrationServices.ctaSub: Iqabane kunye ne-Oklut Technologies yokwakhiwa, ifu elingenamngcipheko kunye nokuphuculwa kwedatha.

pilotPrototyping.description: Uphuhliso olukhawulezayo kunye nokuqinisekiswa kwezisombululo zobuchwepheshe ukuvavanya ukuba nokwenzeka kobugcisa, ixabiso leshishini, iimfuno zokudibanisa, ukusebenza, kunye nokulinganisa ngaphambi kokuphunyezwa ngokupheleleyo.
pilotPrototyping.row1P1: Ukuguqula umbono ube sisisombululo somgangatho woshishino kufuna uqinisekiso lwangaphambili olungqongqo. Inkonzo yethu ye-PoC kunye ne-Pilot ivavanya ukusebenza kwetekhnoloji, uvavanyo loxinzelelo-uvavanyo olubalulekileyo lwekhonkco lokudityaniswa, kwaye iqinisekisa i-ROI yeshishini phambi kokuzinikela okukhulu.
pilotPrototyping.row1P2: Sakha ii-MVP ezithembeke kakhulu kunye nabaqhubi bebhokisi yesanti egxininisekileyo abangqina ukuba nokwenzeka kobugcisa, ukulinganisa ukubambezeleka kwenkqubo, kunye nokuqokelela ukuqinisekiswa okuthe ngqo kwabachaphazelekayo kwangaphambili.
pilotPrototyping.row1Cap: Ukuchwetheza okuKhawulezayo kweMVP kunye neempawu zobuGcisa
pilotPrototyping.row2P1: Sakha iifreyimi zocingo ezisebenzisanayo, ukuhamba komsebenzisi okucofayo, kunye nobungqina obusebenzayo bobungqina ngeentsuku, hayi iinyanga. Vavanya intsebenziswano yabasebenzisi bokwenyani, cokisa iipateni ze-UI/UX, kwaye uqokelele impendulo enokuthanani nabachaphazelekayo.
pilotPrototyping.row2P2: Ngokwenza mfutshane iilophu zengxelo ngexesha lophuhliso kwangethuba, iqela lakho linciphisa ukusebenza kwakhona kwaye limisele iinkcukacha zobugcisa ezicacileyo phambi kokuba kuqale izigaba zokwakha ezixabisa imali eninzi.
pilotPrototyping.row2Cap: Ukuphindaphinda ngokukhawuleza kunye neePrototypes ze-UX ezicofayo
pilotPrototyping.row3P1: Fumanisa imiqobo yobugcisa, imida ye-API, kunye nemiqobo yokusebenza phambi kokuzinikela ngokupheleleyo. Iqela lethu lokulinga ubunjineli livavanya ukudityaniswa koxinzelelo, imibhobho yedatha, kunye nee-API zeqela lesithathu kwiindawo ezikwanti zebhokisi yesanti.
pilotPrototyping.row3P2: Oku kuthomalaliswa komngcipheko kuqinisekisa ukufumaneka kwenkqubo ephezulu, ukuthotyelwa kokhuseleko, kunye namaxesha ophuhliso aqikelelwayo xa utshintshela i-PoC yakho kwimveliso yeshishini.
pilotPrototyping.row3Cap: Ukudityaniswa kwebhokisi yesanti kunye novavanyo loxinzelelo
pilotPrototyping.row4Title: UkuQaliswa koLingelo oLingwayo kunye noQinisekiso lwetyala leShishini
pilotPrototyping.row4P1: Sebenzisa ukhupho lokulinga ekujoliswe kulo kwicandelo elikhethiweyo lomsebenzisi okanye imarike yovavanyo. Landela imilinganiselo yokusebenza, uhlalutyo lokwamkelwa kwabasebenzisi, kunye nengxelo yokusebenza ukulinganisa ixabiso leshishini kunye nokuseka ityala leshishini elixhaswa yidatha.
pilotPrototyping.row4P2: Ngeembono zelinge zehlabathi langempela, abaxhasi abalawulayo bafumana i-ROI metrics ecacileyo ukulungelelanisa ukusasazwa ngokubanzi kunye notyalo-mali lwenguqu yedijithali.
pilotPrototyping.pillarsSub: Imigaqo ekhokelayo ejika ukungaqiniseki kobugcisa kube yimpumelelo yeshishini eliqikelelwayo.
pilotPrototyping.pillar1Desc: Hambisa iiprototypes ezisebenzayo ngokukhawuleza ukuze kuqinisekiswe izindululo zexabiso kwangoko kumjikelo wobomi.
pilotPrototyping.pillar2Desc: Qinisekisa ukuhambelana kwe-API, i-throughput thresholds, kunye nemiqobo yokuthobela kwiindawo zebhokisi yesanti.
pilotPrototyping.pillar3Desc: Linganisa umthwalo wemveliso ukuseka imida yomthamo kunye nokumisela ubungakanani bobungakanani boyilo lwamafu.
pilotPrototyping.pillar4Desc: Ukulinganisa i-ROI ebambekayo kunye neemetrics zemveliso ukuxhasa izigqibo zokuqaliswa kweshishini ngokubanzi.

sharedServices.description: Unikezelo lwethekhnoloji olukwindawo ekumbindi kunye namandla okusebenza kuwo onke amacandelo oshishino ngeenkqubo ezisemgangathweni, izibonelelo zezakhono, izikhokelo zolawulo, ulawulo lweenkonzo, kunye namanqanaba eenkonzo anokulinganiswa.
sharedServices.row1Title: Iinkonzo ezisemgangathweni kuwo onke amaCandelo oShishino
sharedServices.row1P1: Hlanganisa i-IT ye-back-office, ulawulo lweziseko zophuhliso, kunye nenkxaso yobugcisa kwiziko elinye lonikezelo olukumgangatho ophezulu.
sharedServices.row1P2: Ngokususa iqela elisebenza ngokuphindiweyo kunye nokubeka emgangathweni imodeli yonikezelo lwenkonzo, umbutho wakho uqinisekisa umgangatho ongaguqukiyo kwaye uthoba inkcitho yokusebenza iyonke.
sharedServices.row2Title: Ukubeka iliso okuPhambili kunye neSigqibo seZehlo esiKhawulezayo

aiRobotics.intro: I-Artificial Intelligence (AI) kunye neRobhothi ziguqula indlela amashishini asebenza ngayo ngokudibanisa ukwenza izigqibo ezikrelekrele kunye ne-automation ephezulu. I-AI yenza ukuba oomatshini bahlalutye idatha, bafunde iipatheni, kwaye benze izigqibo ezikrelekrele, ngelixa iirobhothi izisa obu buchule kwihlabathi elibonakalayo ukwenza imisebenzi ngesantya, ngokuchanekileyo, kunye nokungaguquguquki.
aiRobotics.section1Text: Izisombululo zethu ze-AI kunye neRobhothi zinceda imibutho ilungelelanise imisebenzi, inciphise iinzame zezandla, kwaye iphucule imveliso kuwo wonke amashishini ahlukeneyo. Ukusuka kwi-automation yenkqubo kunye nohlalutyo oluqikelelweyo ukuya kwiirobhothi ezikrelekrele kunye neenkqubo ezikrelekrele, sihambisa itekhnoloji entsha ephucula ukusebenza kakuhle, ukukhula, kunye nokuxhasa inguqu yedijithali.
aiRobotics.section2Text: Yonke intsebenziswano, isigqibo, kunye nokunyakaza kunikwe amandla yinkqubo enye edibeneyo - ukuguqula idatha kwiziphumo ngexesha langempela.

informationReporting.heroSubtitle: Umthombo omnye wenyaniso kwisebe ngalinye-eyakhelwe ukuguqula idatha yokusebenza ekrwada ibe zizigqibo ishishini lakho elinokuzenza namhlanje.
informationReporting.section1Heading: Inkqubo enye esembindini yemetric nganye ebalulekileyo
informationReporting.section1P1: IiNkqubo zoLwazi kunye neNgxelo zizisombululo ezibalulekileyo zeshishini ezenza ukuba imibutho iqokelele, ilawule, kwaye iguqule idatha ibe yingqiqo enentsingiselo. Ezi nkqubo zidibanisa ulwazi oluvela kumasebe amaninzi, luqinisekisa ukufikelela okuchanekileyo, okuhambelanayo, kunye nexesha lokwenyani kwiinkcukacha zeshishini ezibalulekileyo. Ngokubonelela ngeqonga eliphakathi lolawulo lolwazi, imibutho inokuphucula ukubonakala kokusebenza, ukulungelelanisa ukuhamba komsebenzi, kunye nokuxhasa ukwenziwa kwezigqibo ezicwangcisiweyo kuwo onke amanqanaba eshishini.
informationReporting.section1P2: Ezi nkqubo zisebenzisa ingxelo ezenzekelayo, i-analytics, kunye nedeshibhodi ukulandelela ukusebenza, ukubeka iliso kwiimetriki eziphambili, kunye nokuvelisa iingxelo zexesha langempela. Ngokunciphisa umzamo wezandla kunye nokuphucula ukuchaneka kwedatha, amashishini angenza izigqibo ngokukhawuleza nangempumelelo.
informationReporting.section2Text: Ngokubonakala okuphuculweyo, ukuthotyelwa, kunye nentsebenziswano, iiNkqubo zoLwazi kunye neeNgxelo zenza ukuba imibutho isebenzise iinkqubo, iphucule imveliso, kwaye iqhube ukukhula koshishino oluzinzileyo kwindawo enokhuphiswano.
informationReporting.ctaHeading: Nika iqela ngalinye umfanekiso wexesha lokwenyani ofanayo weshishini.
informationReporting.ctaText: Bona ukuba iiNkqubo zeDatha ye-Nexus zinokudibanisa njani ingxelo yakho ibe yiqonga elinye elikrelekrele.

artificialIntelligence.sec1P1: Kangangeminyaka, ubukrelekrele bokwenziwa kweshishini bebuphathwa njengesakhono sangaphandle: imodeli eqeqeshelwe ukuhlala wedwa, umboniso webhokisi yesanti, okanye i-chatbot eyodwa efikeleleka kwi-portal eyahlukileyo. Namhlanje, i-paradigm itshintshile ngokusisiseko. I-AI yeshishini elinempembelelo ephezulu ifakwe ngqo ngaphakathi kwiinkqubo zerekhodi-ii-ERPs, ii-CRM, iiplatifomu zomntu, kunye neenjini zokubonelela apho ishishini lokwenene lenzeka khona.
artificialIntelligence.sec1P2: Xa i-intelligence isebenza ngaphakathi kwenkqubo yerekhodi, izuza njengelifa imida yokhuseleko olusekiweyo lombutho, imodeli yedatha, kunye nengqiqo yoshishino. Ayenzi nje iimpendulo eziqhelekileyo; isebenza ngokweodolo ephilayo, itolika amatikiti enkxaso evulekileyo, ilungelelanisa ii-invoyisi zababoneleli, kwaye inceda abasebenzi ngaphakathi kojongano oluchanekileyo abahamba ngalo yonke imihla.
artificialIntelligence.sec1P3: Olu tshintsho luhambisa isoftware yeshishini ukusuka kugcino-lwazi olulindileyo ukubetha izitshixo zabantu ukuya kumaqonga asebenzayo alindele iimfuno, amanyathelo azenzekelayo, kunye nezindululo zangexesha.
artificialIntelligence.sec2P1: I-Traditional Robotic Process Automation (RPA) igqwesile kwi-deterministic, i-repetitive screen scraping. Nangona kunjalo, iiseti zomgaqo ongqongqo ziyaqhawuka nanini na xa uxwebhu lutshintsha, uxwebhu obelungalindelekanga lufika, okanye kwenzeke okuthile. I-automation ekrelekrele ibhuloho le yahlulo ngokudibanisa ingqiqo yengqondo kunye nokwenziwa kwentengiselwano:

sec2List.text: Ukuqulunqa imisebenzi entsonkothileyo yamasebe anqamlezileyo, imisebenzi yomzila esekwe kungxamiseko nakwiindlela zosombululo zembali.
Ukungeniswa kweePDF ezingacwangciswanga, ii-imeyile, iimanifest zokuthumela ngenqanawa, kunye neekhontrakthi, ukuziguqulela kwintengiselwano yesiseko sedata ecwangcisiweyo.
Ukuzenzekela ukuqinisekiswa kokusebenza kwamanyathelo amaninzi-okufana neodolo yokuthenga ngokuchasene neerisithi kunye neziteyitimenti zebhanki.
Uhlalutya ngokuqhubekayo iilogi zenkqubo ukuchonga imiqobo yexesha lomjikelo kunye nokucebisa ukuphuculwa kokuhamba komsebenzi okujoliswe kuko.

copilotCards.title: Ulwazi Lokukhangela
copilotCards.desc: Ukufunyanwa kweSemantic kuzo zonke iziseko zolwazi ezisasaziweyo, imigaqo-nkqubo ye-intranethi, ukucaciswa kwemveliso, kunye nezisombululo zamatikiti embali ngaphandle kokuqikelela kwegama elingundoqo.

copilotCards.title: UShwankathelo loxwebhu
copilotCards.desc: I-distillation ekhawulezileyo yee-RFPs ezinde, izivumelwano zabathengisi, iinkcukacha zobugcisa, kunye nezilungiso zomthetho kwiinkcazo zolawulo olusebenzayo kunye noluhlu lokukhangela ingozi.

copilotCards.title: IsiZukulwana soMxholo
copilotCards.desc: Ukuncediswa koyilo lweziphakamiso zabathengi, amaxwebhu okusebenza, iinkqubo zokusebenza ezisemgangathweni (ii-SOPs), kunye nohlaziyo olusemgangathweni lwabathengi oluhambelana nemigangatho yophawu.

copilotCards.title: Uhlalutyo lwedatha
copilotCards.desc: Ukuguqulelwa kwemibuzo yencoko kwimibuzo entsonkothileyo yohlalutyo, ukuvelisa izishwankathelo zetshathi ebhabhayo kwaye kuqaqambise izinto ezibalulekileyo zobunkokeli.

copilotCards.title: Ukuqhutywa koShishino
copilotCards.desc: Ukuqala ukuthengiselana ngokuthe ngqo kwi-chat prompts-njengokucwangcisa izixhobo, ukudala amatikiti, ukuhlaziya iirekhodi, okanye ukungenisa izicelo zokuthenga.

copilotCards.title: UFikelelo oluSetyenziselwe indima
copilotCards.desc: Ukuqinisekisa ukuba iimpendulo zabakopishi zihlonipha ngokungqongqo amanqanaba emvume yabasebenzisi, ukugcina imali eyimfihlo, iifayile zeHR, kunye nepropathi enomgangatho ophezulu wokuqonda ekhuselweyo.

artificialIntelligence.sec4P1: Ngelixa imifuziselo evelisa imveliso igqwesa ekuqondeni nasekuhlanganiseni ulwimi, ubukrelekrele bokuxela kwangaphambili bujolise kwiipateni zemathematika ezifihlwe kwiiseti zedatha zeshishini. Iimodeli eziqikelelweyo zokuxela kwangaphambili zixhobisa imibutho ukuba ilindele imiqobo yokusebenza ngaphambi kokuba iphazamise ukusebenza:

sec4List.text: Ukuqikelela iintsingiselo zengeniso, isantya soluhlu lweempahla, kunye neemfuno zezibonelelo ngokudibanisa izikhombisi zamaxesha onyaka kunye nesantya semibhobho yexesha lokwenyani.
Ukukhomba imingcipheko yechurn yabathengi, imijikelo yokuthotywa kogcino, kunye nokulibaziseka kwekhonkco lonikezelo ngelixa kusekho ixesha lokungenelela.
Ukuphawula okungaqhelekanga kwiintengiselwano zemali, iilog zokuthotyelwa, kunye neepatheni zokuthengwa komthengisi phambi kokuba zinyuke.
Ukungqinelanisa uqikelelo lwentengiso kunye nomthamo wokwenziwa kwemveliso kunye namanqanaba estokhwe sogcino ukukhusela inkunzi yokusebenza.

artificialIntelligence.keyPerspectiveLead: I-AI ixhomekeke kuphela njengesiseko sedatha phantsi kwayo kunye nolawulo oluyingqongileyo. Ukwamkelwa kweshishini elizinzileyo kufuna uqeqesho loyilo lolwakhiwo ngabom:

modernErp.subtitle: Phonononga indlela amaqonga e-ERP anamhlanje adibanisa ngayo imali, ukuthenga, ukubonelela kunye nemisebenzi yoshishino ngesiseko esimanyeneyo sedijithali.

connectedFunctions.desc: Uhlaziyo lweleja yexesha langempela, ukuqondwa kwengeniso ezenzekelayo, kunye noxolelwaniso lwemali eninzi ngoko nangoko.

connectedFunctions.title: Ikhonkco lonikezelo & noLungiselelo
connectedFunctions.desc: Ukuphela-ukuya-ekupheleni koluhlu lwezinto ezibonakalayo, ukulungiswa kwendawo yokugcina, kunye ne-telemetry yokusebenza komthengisi.

connectedFunctions.title: UPhuhliso lwaBasebenzi kunye naBasebenzi
connectedFunctions.desc: Iiphothali zabasebenzi abazisebenzelayo, ii-automated payroll runs, kunye nokucwangciswa komjikelo wetalente odibeneyo wokuphila.

connectedFunctions.title: Ukuthengwa kweempahla neenkonzo
connectedFunctions.desc: Imvume yokuthenga ngokuzenzekelayo, ukuthotyelwa kwekhontrakthi yomthengisi, kunye nohlalutyo lwenkcitho oluguquguqukayo.

modernCapabilities.title: Cloud-Native Architecture
modernCapabilities.desc: Elastic compute scaling ngaphandle kweziseko ezingundoqo eziphezu kwesakhiwo okanye uguqulelo oluphazamisayo lokutshixelwa.

modernCapabilities.title: Vula i-API Ecosystem
modernCapabilities.desc: Iziqhagamshelo ezakhelwe kwangaphambili zenza ungqamaniso lwedatha olungenamthungo lwendlela-mbini kunye neemicroservices zesiko kunye nee-CRM suites.

modernCapabilities.title: Uhlalutyo oluhlonyelweyo
modernCapabilities.desc: I-deshboard drill-downs ngokuthe ngqo ukusuka kwibalance sheets yomgangatho ophezulu ukuya kwiilog zentengiselwano nganye.

modernCapabilities.title: Ii-Automated Workflow Triggers
modernCapabilities.desc: Isiganeko esiqhutywa sisiganeko sixhokonxa ukwenziwa kwemisebenzi esemgangathweni yesebe ngokuzimeleyo.

Unciphiso olumandla kwimijikelo yokuphela kwenyanga neyokuphela kwekota
Uluhlu lweempahla lwexesha lokwenyani kunye nokubonakala kolungiselelo kunciphisa ukuphela kwamayeza
Ukunciphisa ukugcinwa kwe-IT ngaphezulu kwemodyuli ye-cloud-native updates
Ukulandelwa kokuthotyelwa okumanyeneyo kulawulo lwerhafu yeengingqi ezininzi
Ukungena ngokukhawuleza kwamaqumrhu afunyenweyo kumqolo wokusebenza okwabelwana ngawo
erpStrategyPoints: Ukulungelelanisa uyilo lweERP kunye nokuhamba komsebenzi okungundoqo ngaphambi koqwalaselo
Ukukhetha iimodeli zokusasazwa kweemodyuli ukuqonda impumelelo ekhawulezileyo
Ukubeka phambili ukufuduka kwedatha ekumgangatho ophezulu kunye noxolelwaniso
Ukufakela ulawulo lotshintsho oluzenzekelayo kunye neenkqubo zoqeqesho ezilungiselelwe indima
Ukuyila amasango e-API ukwenzela ukwandiswa kohlanganiso lwexesha elizayo olungenamkhuhlane
modernErp.sec1Subtext: I-ERP ayiseyiyo nje i-back-office accounting. Yimodeli yokusebenza yeshishini langoku elichazwe kwisoftware.
modernErp.sec2Subtext: Ixabiso lokwenene lombutho livela xa imisebenzi engundoqo yoshishino isebenzisana kunye kwisiseko sedijithali ekwabelwana ngaso.
modernErp.sec3Subtext: Ukwaphula iindonga zonxibelelwano phakathi kwamasebe ukuze kusebenze ulwelo, ulungelelwaniso lweshishini.
modernErp.sec4Subtext: Ukuhlanganisa iimetrics zokusebenza kwiideshbhodi zolawulo ezingafihliyo ezibonisa iinyani zangoku zoshishino.
modernErp.sec5Subtext: Iimpawu zoyilo ezahlula amaqonga e-ERP angoku kunye nofakelo oluluqilima lwelifa.
modernErp.sec6Subtext: Ukudibanisa imisebenzi engundoqo yoshishino kwisiseko esimanyeneyo sedijithali kuvelisa ukomelela kombutho okunokulinganiswa.
modernErp.ctaDescription: Phonononga indlela amaqonga e-ERP anamhlanje adibanisa ngayo imali, ukuthenga, ukubonelela kunye nemisebenzi yoshishino ngesiseko esimanyeneyo sedijithali.
modernErp.sec1P1: Kwiindawo zamashishini ezihamba ngokukhawuleza, iinkqubo zesiqhelo zoCwangciso lweziBonelelo zoShishino zihlala zitsala nzima. Yakhelwe kwixesha lokusetyenzwa kwebhetshi kunye neeseva zasekhaya ezikwanti, ii-ERP zelifa zenziwe ngokwezifiso kakhulu, kunzima ukuziphucula, kwaye kabuhlungu opaque. Imisebenzi ebalulekileyo yoshishino isebenze kwiisileyile ezinxuseneyo, ixhomekeke kuthunyelo kumazwe angaphandle oluethe-ethe ubusuku bonke ukulungelelanisa iileja kunye noovimba.
modernErp.sec1P2: I-ERP yangoku, yamafu ichaza ngokutsha oku kuguquguqukayo. Isebenza njengomqolo wedijithali odityanisiweyo weshishini-isiseko esiphilayo apho imali, ukuthengwa kwempahla, ikhonkco lokubonelela, i-inventory, kunye nezibonelelo zabantu zisebenza kwimodeli yedatha ekwabelwanayo.
modernErp.sec1P3: Ngokuzisa imisebenzi engundoqo kwindawo enye ehambelanayo, iERP yanamhlanje iphelisa iindawo ezingaboniyo zokusebenza ezicothisa ukukhula, okwenza iinkokeli ziqhube ishishini zisebenzisa imiqondiso yexesha lokwenyani kunezishwankathelo zembali zakudala.
modernErp.sec3P1: Izisele ezisebenzayo azifane zibe ziingxaki zabantu; ziingxaki zezokwakha. Xa inkonzo yabathengi, ukuthengwa, kunye namaqela okugcina asebenza kwizicelo ezivaliweyo, yonke i-handoff ifuna i-imeyile yesandla, i-spreadsheets, kunye neefowuni. Iimpazamo ziyaphindaphindeka, ii-invoyisi ziyagcinwa, kwaye izibophelelo zabathengi ziyatyibilika.
modernErp.sec3P2: I-ERP yale mihla ilungisa oku ngokusebenzisa umnombo wedatha odityanisiweyo kunye nenkqubo eqhutywa sisiganeko:

sec3List.text: Xa iodolo yomthengi ifakiwe, uluhlu lwempahla lugcina ngokuzenzekelayo, iileyibhile zokuthumela zivelisa, kwaye iileja zokuhlawula zihlaziywa ngoko nangoko.
Iiodolo zokuthenga, iirisithi zempahla, kunye nee-invoyisi zomthengisi zihambelana ngokuzenzekelayo noxolelwaniso lweendlela ezi-3, zifake iflegi kuphela ngaphandle kokuhlolwa komntu.
Amaxwebhu exesha eprojekthi, ulwabiwo lwemivuzo, kunye nenkcitho ethe ngqo yokusebenza kwimephu ngqo kumaziko eendleko ngexesha lokwenyani.

modernErp.sec4P1: Ukuqhuba ishishini ngaphandle kokubonakala okumanyeneyo kufana nokubhabha kwinkungu eshinyeneyo enezixhobo ezilibazisekayo. I-ERP yanamhlanje ibonelela nge-telemetry yexesha lokwenyani kuwo wonke umlinganiselo weshishini:

sec4List.text: Iimbono ezikhawulezileyo zegross margins, uqukuqelo lwemali esebenzayo, amatyala avulelekileyo, kunye nokuodola ukusilela ngaphandle kokulinda ukuvalwa kwexesha lokuphela.
Iintloko zamasebe zingakha imibuzo elungiselelweyo kwaye zehle ukusuka kwizishwankathelo zenqanaba loshishino ukuya kwizinto zomda wentengiselwano.
Ukuphelisa amanani aphikisanayo ngokuseka idatha elawulwayo eyodwa kubathengi, abathengisi, kunye neekhathalogu zeemveliso.
Izilumkiso ezizenzekelayo zazisa abaphathi ngokukhawuleza xa imida yehla ngaphantsi komqobo, uluhlu lwempahla luhla, okanye isiliphu sokuhanjiswa komthengisi.

cybersecurity.sec1Subtext: Njengoko imibutho yanamhlanje idibanisa izicelo ezininzi, indawo zefu, abasebenzi abakude, izixhobo eziphathwayo, kunye namaqabane eqela lesithathu, i-perimeter yokhuseleko yendabuko iyayeka ukubakho.
cybersecurity.sec2Subtext: Ukhuselo olusebenzayo olukhusela iziseko ezingundoqo ezibalulekileyo, iinkcukacha ezibuthathaka zamashishini, kunye neenkqubo zokusebenza.
cybersecurity.sec3Subtext: Isazisi sisiseko solawulo lwenqwelomoya yokhuseleko lwangoku. Phantse zonke izenzo zolwaphulo-mthetho ezimandundu ziqala ngeziqinisekiso ezithotyiweyo kunokusebenzisa isoftware.
cybersecurity.sec4Subtext: Zero Trust ayiyomveliso okanye isixhobo esinye. Sisicwangciso soyilo esisekwe kumgaqo othe ngqo: ungathembeli qumrhu ngaphakathi okanye ngaphandle kwenethiwekhi ngokungagqibekanga.
cybersecurity.sec5Subtext: Ukukhusela umthwalo wokusebenza kuwo wonke amafu kawonke-wonke, ulwakhiwo oluxubeneyo, kunye neendawo ezisasaziweyo zeekhonteyina.
cybersecurity.sec6Subtext: Ukomelela kwe-cyber okwenyani kwamkela ukuba izehlo zingenzeka. Ukulungiselela kugxile ekugcinweni ngokukhawuleza, ukuphazamiseka okuncinci kweshishini, kunye nokuqinisekiswa kokubuyisela.
cybersecurity.sec7Subtext: Ukwakha ishishini elisebenza kwi-cyber-resilient likhusela ixabiso lombutho, ukuma kolawulo, kunye nodumo lwemarike.
cybersecurity.ctaDescription: Phonononga indlela imibutho enokomeleza ngayo ukhuseleko, ikhusele iinkqubo ezibalulekileyo kwaye ilungiselele izoyikiso kuzo zonke iindawo eziqhagamsheleneyo.
cybersecurity.sec1P1: Ngexesha lelifa le-IT yeshishini, ukhuseleko lwalusebenza kwimfundiso ye-castle-and-moat: yonke into engaphakathi kuthungelwano lweofisi yenkampani yayicingelwa ukuba inokuthenjwa, ngelixa yonke into engaphandle yayithathwa njengengathenjwa. I-firewall enye yenkampani ekhuselweyo iiseva zangaphakathi, idatabase, kunye neekhompyuter zedesktop.
cybersecurity.sec1P2: Ishishini lanamhlanje liye lakhula ngaphandle kweendonga zomzimba. Umthwalo wemisebenzi uhlala kwiindawo ezininzi ezinamafu amaninzi (i-AWS, i-Azure, i-GCP), abasebenzi bafikelela kwizicelo zoshishino ukusuka kwiindawo ezahlukeneyo, kwaye ii-APIs zihlala zitshintshiselana ngedatha yokusebenza enobuthathaka kunye nababoneleli bezothutho bangaphandle, amaziko emali, kunye nabathengisi be-SaaS.
cybersecurity.sec1P3: Ngelixa olu qhagamshelo luqhubela phambili ukusebenza kakuhle kweshishini, lwandisa kakhulu umphezulu wohlaselo lweshishini. Yonke isiphelo se-API, ithokheni yesazisi, isixhobo esineselfowuni esiqhagamshelweyo, kunye nodibaniso lwe-SaaS lumele i-vector enokubakho yokuvezwa. Ukhuseleko lweshishini lokwenyani lufuna ukutshintshwa ukusuka kukhuselo olusekwe kwi-perimeter ukuya kwi-proactive, ekupheleni ukuya ekupheleni kokuqina kwe-cyber.

sec2Cards.title: Ukufunyanwa kwesoyikiso
sec2Cards.desc: Ubukrelekrele bokunceda ukufunda ngomatshini obujonga iipateni zothungelwano ezingaqhelekanga, ukusetyenziswa kakubi kwengqinisekiso, kunye nobuthathaka beentsuku zero ngexesha lokwenyani.

sec2Cards.title: Ukubeka iliso kuKhuseleko
sec2Cards.desc: Iziko leMisebenzi yoKhuseleko olukumbindileyo (SOC) olunxibelelanisa imisitho yetelemetry kuzo zonke iiseva, amaqela eekhonteyina, ababoneleli bezazisi, kunye neendawo zokuphela.

sec2Cards.title: Ulawulo lokwenzakala
sec2Cards.desc: Ukukhangela ukuba semngciphekweni okuzisebenzelayo okuthe gqolo kuzo zonke iziseko zophuhliso, iindawo zokugcina ikhowudi yomthombo, kunye neerejistri zeekhonteyina ukulungisa ubuthathaka ngokubonakalayo.

sec2Cards.title: Ukhuseleko lweenkcukacha
sec2Cards.desc: I-encryption eyomeleleyo ekuhambeni (TLS 1.3) kunye nokuphumla (AES-256), kunye nolawulo lwe-granular data loss prevention (DLP) ukukhusela ukuvuza kwepropathi yengqondo.

cybersecurity.sec3P1: Ukukhusela ii-asethi zeshishini kufuna ukuba kuqinisekiswe ukuba zonke iinkcukacha—nokuba ngumntu olawulayo, unokontraka wangaphandle, okanye i-akhawunti yenkonzo yesoftware ezimeleyo—iqinisekise ugunyaziso lwezona zibonelelo zilufumanayo.

sec3List.text: Ukusayinwa okukodwa (i-SSO) kunye nemigangatho yesazisi edibeneyo esusa iivenkile eziqhekezayo zeephasiwedi kuzo zonke izicelo.
Phishing-resistant FIDO2 izitshixo zehardware kunye nemingeni esekelwe kumngcipheko wemeko yemisebenzi yolawulo enovakalelo.
I-Fine-grained Role-Based (RBAC) kunye ne-Attribute-Based Based (ABAC) ulawulo lokufikelela olunyanzeliswa kwi-API kunye namanqanaba edatha.
Ukunika ufikelelo lwexeshana, nje-ngexesha (JIT) oluphelelwa ngokuzenzekelayo xa imisebenzi yolawulo igqityiwe.

cloudModernization.sec1Subtext: Ii-monoliths ezigugayo zinyanzelisa isantya sokwenziwa kwezinto ezintsha, zandise ubuthathaka bokusebenza, kwaye zinyusa iindleko zokulondolozwa kwezakhiwo.
cloudModernization.sec2Subtext: Uphuculo lwamafu oluyimpumelelo luqala ngovavanyo olungqongqo. Ukutsibela ngqo kwimfuduko ngaphandle kokuxhomekeka kwesicelo sophicotho-zincwadi ngoyena nobangela wokulibaziseka kokunciphisa.
cloudModernization.sec3Subtext: Akukho sicwangciso sokufuduka esilingana nobukhulu obunye. Amashishini aphambili ahambelana nepateni efanelekileyo yokuphucula umsebenzi ngamnye ngokusekwe kwixabiso leshishini, ukungxamiseka, kunye netyala lobugcisa.
cloudModernization.sec4Subtext: Imephu yendlela eyakhiweyo eguqula i-monoliths yelifa ibe yi-elastic, ekhuselekileyo, kunye neenkonzo zefu ezilondolozekayo.
cloudModernization.sec5Subtext: Ukuhambisa iinkqubo zelifa kuyilo lwale mihla lwamafu kuzisa ubuchule obubambekayo bokusebenza kunye nokuqikelelwa kweendleko.

cloudModernization.sec1P1: Izicelo ezingundoqo ezakhiwe kwiminyaka elishumi eyadlulayo zisaqhuba iibhiliyoni kwingeniso yeshishini, ukanti ukuqina kwazo koyilo kudala umngcipheko wokusebenza okhulayo.
cloudModernization.sec1P2: Ishishini ngalinye lijongene noxinzelelo phakathi kozinzo kunye nophuculo. Iinkqubo zelifa zenzelwe ukuhlala ixesha elide, kwaye ziye zasebenza ngokuthembekileyo iminyaka. Nangona kunjalo, njengoko iimfuno zeshishini zikhawuleza, ezi zakhiwo zokudala zidibana nemida yolwakhiwo:

sec1List.text: Iziseko zekhowudi ze-Monolithic ezakhelwe kwiziseko ezilahliweyo ezinamaqula eetalente ezinciphayo akhoyo ukuze agcinwe.
Amacandelo adityaniswe ngokuqinileyo apho ukutshintsha uphawu olunye kunobungozi bokwaphula iimodyuli zokusebenza ezinganxulumananga.
Imida yokukala ethe nkqo efuna ukuthengwa kwezixhobo zexabiso ezixabisa ubunini ukuze kuhlangatyezwane nokunyuka kwetrafikhi ngamaxesha athile onyaka.
Ukungakwazi ukusebenzisana kakuhle ne-apps zala maxesha eziphathwayo, iiphothali zabathengi, okanye ii-APIs zamahlakani ngaphandle kwemibhalo eethe-ethe yebhetshi.
Umjikelo wobomi begumbi leseva ebonakalayo, ubuthathaka bokugcina, kunye nenkcitho ephezulu yokusebenza kwamandla/okupholisa.

cloudModernization.sec2P1: Uhambo lophuculo lwepragmatic luqala ngokuseka ingcaciso epheleleyo kulo lonke ilizwe elikhoyo:

sec2List.text: Ukulungisa yonke imisebenzi esebenzayo, iimodyuli zesiko, izikripthi ezingasemva, kunye neepakethe zembali zomntu wesithathu.
Ukwenza imephu yokudibanisa ixesha lokubaleka elinzima, iitafile zedatha ekwabelwana ngayo, iifowuni zenkqubo yefayile ngokuthe ngqo, kunye nezivumelwano zenkonzo zangaphandle.
Ukuphonononga ubume bedatha, iimfuno zentengiselwano yemfezeko, i-backup cadence, kunye nemithetho yolawulo yolongamo.
Ukuphicothwa kwe-CPU, imemori, ukusetyenziswa kokugcinwa, kunye nokugqithiswa kwenethiwekhi kwi-right-size target target specifications cloud.
Ukwahlula izicelo ngokwamanqanaba ukuyila amaza okufuduka akhuselekileyo, anezigaba kunye neenkqubo ezicacileyo zokubuyela umva.

cloudModernization.sec4P1: Uyilo lwendawo ekuyiwa kuyo luqhawula usetyenziso olungundoqo lube ziimodyuli, iinkonzo ezifakwe kwiikhonteyina ezibanjwe kumaqonga amafu anwebekayo (afana neKubernetes okanye amaxesha okusebenza angenaseva).
cloudModernization.sec4P2: Ngokuseka i-automated CI/CD pipelines deployment, i-automated blue-green cutovers, kunye neziseko zophuhliso njengekhowudi, ukuthunyelwa kuguqulwa kwiziganeko zempelaveki eziphazamisayo zibe yinkqubo yemihla ngemihla engenamthungo.
cloudModernization.sec4P3: Icompute ene-elastic ikhula ngokuzenzekelayo ngexesha lokunyuka kwemfuno kunye nezikali ezantsi ngexesha lokuthomalalisa, isusa iindleko zezibonelelo ezingasebenziyo ngelixa iqinisekisa amaxesha okuphendula kwi-sub-second kubasebenzisi behlabathi.
